verdict.rationale: Unleash's quickstart provides a ready-to-use hosted instance with no local setup. The developer creates a first feature flag in the Admin UI and connects an SDK. Activation strategies then enable or disable features without redeploying, and per-environment configuration lets a flag be toggled specifically in production. Missing for 10: hands-on or independent evidence that signup-to-live-production-toggle actually takes only minutes, and explicit documentation of the signup/trial flow timing.
